name: photo-revive
desc: Free, open-source photo restoration for Windows — upscale, denoise and colorize old scans locally. 100 MB portable, offline, MIT, no account.
features: ✅ **Scan repair pipeline** — denoise, sharpen and upscale in one pass tuned for old photo scans
✅ **Colorize mode** — grayscale photos get sensible color from a local model with a strength slider
✅ **4x upscaling** — Real-ESRGAN-class models take a 600 px scan to print-worthy size
✅ **Face restore pass** — optional GFPGAN-style enhancement for portraits that lost detail
✅ **Before and after view** — wipe divider compares original and result at matching zoom
✅ **Batch family albums** — run a folder of scans overnight with consistent settings
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, models download separately, offline after that, MIT
compare: | Feature | **photo-revive** | Photoshop Neural Filters | MyHeritage | Web restore services |
| Price | **Free, MIT** | Paid subscription | Paid | Credits |
| Photos stay local | **Yes** | Yes | Upload | Upload
| Batch album runs | **Yes** | Manual | No | No
| Colorize plus upscale in one pass | **Yes** | Separate filters | Yes | Partial
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Installer | Browser | Browser
faqQ: how to restore old family photos without paying per image?
faqA: Restoration services charge per photo and want the family archive uploaded, and desktop suites cost a subscription. photo-revive denoises, upscales and colorizes locally with a face restore pass for portraits. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, unlimited, offline — one evening restores the whole album.
s1: Dark studio (#121418, sepia #D97706): wipe divider over a restored portrait at 4x, pipeline toggles for denoise, upscale and colorize all on, face restore badge lit.
s2: Batch album view: 120 scans queued with previews, consistent settings locked, progress bar, ETA chip reading 22 minutes.
s3: Compare mode: original grayscale left, colorized right, strength slider at 0.7, detail zoom inset showing recovered facial texture.
